scripts.setup: pnpm install && cd apps/api && uv sync && uv run alembic upgrade head && uv run python -m app.seed import --all
scripts.dev:api: cd apps/api && uv run fastapi dev app/main.py
scripts.gen:api: cd apps/api && uv run python -m app.export_openapi ../web/openapi.json && cd ../web && pnpm gen:api
scripts.lint: pnpm --filter web lint && cd apps/api && uv run ruff check .
scripts.test: pnpm --filter web test && cd apps/api && uv run pytest
